es: Comparar dos barrios con conectores, correlativos y referencias: leer datos, escribir una comparación cohesionada, defender una preferencia y responder a una objeción.

teaching.en: Riverside is cheaper, whereas Hilltop is quieter.
teaching.es: Riverside es más barato, mientras que Hilltop es más tranquilo.
teaching.explanationEs: Whereas contrasta dos barrios en una sola frase. Con adjetivos cortos, -er: cheaper, quieter.
teaching.audioText: Riverside is cheaper, whereas Hilltop is quieter.

teaching.en: Both neighbourhoods have a library; however, neither has a cinema.
teaching.es: Los dos barrios tienen biblioteca; sin embargo, ninguno tiene cine.
teaching.explanationEs: Both… y neither resumen lo común; however marca el contraste con punto y coma.
teaching.audioText: Both neighbourhoods have a library; however, neither has a cinema.

teaching.en: Rather than live in the centre, many families choose Riverside.
teaching.es: En lugar de vivir en el centro, muchas familias eligen Riverside.
teaching.explanationEs: Rather than presenta la opción que se descarta; la elegida va después.
teaching.audioText: Rather than live in the centre, many families choose Riverside.

teaching.en: Hilltop has neither a cinema nor a market, but it has clean air.
teaching.es: Hilltop no tiene ni cine ni mercado, pero tiene aire limpio.
teaching.explanationEs: Neither… nor niega las dos cosas con un verbo afirmativo; but añade la ventaja.
segments: Hilltop has neither a cinema nor a
market, but it has clean air.
teaching.audioText: Hilltop has neither a cinema nor a market, but it has clean air.

teaching.en: I prefer Riverside because it is cheaper and closer to work.
teaching.es: Prefiero Riverside porque es más barato y está más cerca del trabajo.
teaching.explanationEs: Preferencia justificada: I prefer X to Y + because + razones. It evita repetir el barrio.
segments: I prefer Riverside because it is
teaching.audioText: I prefer Riverside because it is cheaper and closer to work.

teaching.en: Some say Riverside is noisy; that may be true, but the price matters more to me.
teaching.es: Algunos dicen que Riverside es ruidoso; puede ser cierto, pero el precio me importa más.
teaching.explanationEs: Responder a una objeción: reconoce (that may be true), contrasta con but y da tu razón.
segments: Some say Riverside is noisy; that may be
true, but the price matters more to me.
teaching.audioText: Some say Riverside is noisy; that may be true, but the price matters more to me.

Riverside is cheaper and closer to work, whereas Hilltop is quieter.

Either has a library, and both have a cinema.

choices.text: Opened a library.
Moved to another home.
Visited the cinema.

origin.text: Both Riverside and Hilltop are growing. The former is cheaper; the latter is quieter. Some families wanted to move, and a few did so last month.

prompt.es: Compara los dos barrios en un párrafo cohesionado y defiende tu preferencia.

answer.text: Riverside is cheaper and closer to work, whereas Hilltop is quieter. Riverside is only ten minutes from work, but Hilltop is 35 minutes away. Both neighbourhoods have a library, but neither has a cinema. Some people say that Riverside is too noisy. That may be true; however, the price and the short trip matter more to me. As a result, I prefer Riverside to Hilltop.
accepted: Riverside is cheaper and closer to work, whereas Hilltop is quieter. Riverside is only ten minutes from work, but Hilltop is 35 minutes away. Both neighbourhoods have a library, but neither has a cinema. Some people say that Riverside is too noisy. That may be true; however, the price and the short trip matter more to me. As a result, I prefer Riverside to Hilltop.

Riverside is cheaper, and it is closer to work. Hilltop, however, is quieter. Both have a library, but neither has a cinema. You may be right that Riverside is noisy, but I prefer it because it is cheaper and the trip to work is short.

Although Hilltop is quieter, Riverside is cheaper and closer to work. Neither neighbourhood has a cinema. Both neighbourhoods have a library, so the choice is about money and time. I understand that Riverside is noisy, but the price matters more, so I prefer Riverside.

feedback.es: Una comparación cohesionada contrasta los datos, usa both o neither, evita repetir con it y termina con una preferencia que responde a la objeción.

origin.text: Datos. Riverside: alquiler 400 $, 10 minutos al trabajo, ruidoso, biblioteca. Hilltop: alquiler 550 $, 35 minutos al trabajo, tranquilo, biblioteca. Cine: ninguno de los dos. Objeción: «Riverside es demasiado ruidoso».

prompt.es: Relaciona cada herramienta con lo que hace en la comparación.

feedback.es: Cada herramienta cumple una función: whereas contrasta, neither… nor niega, the former señala y I prefer… to… elige.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué prefiere Hilltop.

choices.text: Because the rent there is lower.
Because the trip to work is shorter.
Because the streets there are calmer.

feedback.es: La hablante reconoce que Riverside es más barato (objeción), pero elige Hilltop por ser más tranquilo.

origin.audio: Riverside is cheaper, and I agree that price matters. However, I prefer Hilltop because it is quieter.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta reconoce la objeción y mantiene la preferencia?

choices.text: That may be true, but the price matters more to me.
That is false and you know nothing.
You are right, so I will choose Hilltop.

feedback.es: Reconoce el punto (That may be true) y mantiene su preferencia con un dato. Atacar o rendirse no responde bien a la objeción.
